name: Aglaonema commutatum (Chinese Evergreen)
description: Aglaonema commutatum is a terrestrial plant native to tropical regions of Southeast Asia, particularly the Philippines and Indonesia. It belongs to the Araceae family and features upright stems with broad, lance-shaped leaves that are typically green with silver or gray patterning. The plant has an upright, bushy growth habit and thrives in warm, humid conditions with indirect or filtered light. In tropical forests it grows as an understory plant. It is widely grown as a houseplant for its tolerance of low light and easy care. Toxic if ingested.
careTips: Keep soil consistently moist but well-draining
Low to bright indirect light; tolerates low light
Toxic if ingested - keep away from pets and children
